exposure: 5 different definitions of abnormal umbilical cord gas studies
cohort: 3001 singleton cesarean deliveries at 37(0/7)-41(6/7) weeks of gestation
finding: There was no correlation between abnormal umbilical cord gas studies and composite adverse neonatal outcome.
mod_finding: This study, examining singleton term cesarean deliveries, found no correlation between abnormal umbilical cord gas studies and composite adverse neonatal outcomes.
